scripts.cap:build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& '.\gradlew' assembleDebug"
scripts.cap:bundle:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& '.\gradlew' bundleRelease"
scripts.android:bundletool:build: npm run android:bundletool:bundle && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$bundleToolJar = $env:BUNDLETOOL_JAR; if (-not $bundleToolJar) { $bundleToolJar = 'C:\\tmp\\bundletool.jar' }; if (-not (Test-Path $bundleToolJar)) { throw 'Bundletool nao encontrado. Defina BUNDLETOOL_JAR ou coloque o jar em C:\tmp\bundletool.jar' }; if (-not (Test-Path 'android\\app\\build\\outputs\\bundle\\release\\app-release.aab')) { throw 'AAB nao encontrado. Rode npm run cap:bundle:android antes.' }; java -jar $bundleToolJar build-apks --bundle='android\\app\\build\\outputs\\bundle\\release\\app-release.aab' --output='C:\\tmp\\cifras.apks' --mode=universal"
scripts.android:bundletool:install: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$bundleToolJar = $env:BUNDLETOOL_JAR; if (-not $bundleToolJar) { $bundleToolJar = 'C:\\tmp\\bundletool.jar' }; if (-not (Test-Path $bundleToolJar)) { throw 'Bundletool nao encontrado. Defina BUNDLETOOL_JAR ou coloque o jar em C:\tmp\bundletool.jar' }; if (-not (Test-Path 'C:\\tmp\\cifras.apks')) { throw 'APKs nao encontrados. Rode npm run android:bundletool:build antes.' }; java -jar $bundleToolJar install-apks --apks='C:\\tmp\\cifras.apks'"
